items.label: text
items.text: This is a summary of some of themost useful organic conversions thatyou havelearned on your International AS/A Level course.

items.label: table
items.text:
| CONVERSION                                        | EQUATION                                | REAGENT                                         | CONDITIONS                                                                    |
|---------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Alkene to halogenoalkane                          | CH=CH2+HX→CHCHX                         | hydrogen halide                                 | mix the gases at room temperature                                             |
| Halogenoalkanetoalcohol                           | RX+NaOH→ROH+NaX                         | aqueous sodium hydroxide                        | heat underreflux                                                              |
| Halogenoalkane to nitrile                         | RX+KCN→RCN+KX                           | alcoholicpotassiumcyanide                       | heatunderreflux                                                               |
| Halogenoalkane to amine                           | RX+2NH→RNH2+NHX                         | aqueousammonia                                  | heat underpressure                                                            |
| Alcoholtochloroalkane                             | ROH+PCIs→RCI+HCI+POCl                   | phosphorus(V) chloride                          | roomtemperature                                                               |
| Alcoholtobromoalkane                              | ROH +HBr→RBr +H2O                       | 50%concentratedsulfuric acidandpotassiumbromide | warm                                                                          |
| Alcoholtoiodoalkane                               | 3ROH+Pl→3RI+HPO3                        | red phosphorus and iodine                       | heat under reflux                                                             |
| Primary alcohol to aldehyde                       | RCH2OH+[O]→RCHO+H2O                     | potassium dichromate(VI) anddilutesulfuricacid  | addthereagenttohotalcohol and allow the aldehyde todistil off as it is formed |
| Primary alcohol to carboxylic acid                | RCHOH+2[O]→RCOOH+HO                     | potassium dichromate(VI) anddilute sulfuricacid | heat underreflux                                                              |
| Secondaryalcoholtoketone                          | RCH(OH)R'+[O] →RCOR'+H2O                | potassium dichromate(VI) anddilutesulfuricacid  | heat underreflux                                                              |
| Aldehydetoprimaryalcohol                          | RCHO+2[H]→RCH2OH                        | lithium aluminium hydride in dry ether          | roomtemperature                                                               |
| Ketonetosecondary alcohol                         | RCOR'+2[H]→RCH(OH)R                     | lithium aluminium hydride in dry ether          | roomtemperature                                                               |
| Aldehydeandketoneto 2-hydroxynitrile              | RCHO+HCN→RCH(OH)CN RCOR'+HCN→RR'C(OH)CN | potassium cyanide in dilute sulfuricacid        | 10-20°℃                                                                       |
| Carboxylic acid to primary alcohol                | RCOOH+4[H]→RCH2OH+H2O                   | lithium aluminium hydride in dryether           | roomtemperature                                                               |
| Carboxylicacidtoester                             | RCOOH+R'OH→RCOOR'+H2O                   | alcoholandconcentrated sulfuric acid            | heat                                                                          |
| Acylchloridetocarboxylic acid                     | RCOCI+HO→RCOOH+HCI                      | water                                           | roomtemperature                                                               |
| Acylchloridetoester                               | RCOCI+R'OH→RCOOR'+HCI                   | alcohol                                         | roomtemperature                                                               |
| Acylchloride toprimary amide                      | RCOCI+2NH3→RCONH2+ NH,CI                | aqueous ammonia                                 | roomtemperature                                                               |
| Acylchloridetosecondary amide(N-substitutedamide) | RCOCI+R'NH2→RCONHR'+HCI                 | amine                                           | roomtemperature                                                               |
